question: Which chapter of the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa concludes with devotee characteristics?
premises: The text is identified as the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
This is the chapter on the marks of devotees.
It is numbered as the ninety-first.
inference: The ninety-first chapter on the marks of devotees in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa is concluded.
plain_english: Thus ends the ninety-first chapter, on the marks of devotees, in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
